commit.message: feat(desktop): align stored memory metrics and actions

specification.objective: Rearrange Stored memory metrics into three values on the first row and a character-budget bar on the second, and combine search, target switcher, and Add/Compact actions into a responsive toolbar.

requirements.statement: Show Entries, Estimated tokens, Characters in that order in the first statistics row; show Character budget, percentage, bar and remaining free-character feedback across the second row.
Place Search stored memory, Memory/User target switch, Add entry and Compact with AI in the same toolbar beside the list; remove the old extra controls row and search-field row.
Toolbar and statistics remain accessible at narrow widths with no horizontal overflow; preserve names, aria-pressed, focus visibility, status feedback, selected target and loading/disabled states.
Keep all underlying memory operations, REST contracts, compaction preview/apply flow, selection/filtering and resize behavior unchanged; update only Desktop UI and scoped tests.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A regression test checks a three-item statistic row ordered Entries/Estimated tokens/Characters followed by a separate full-width budget row preserving progress and free-character indicators.
A regression test verifies the single combined toolbar contains the existing search, target group and Add/Compact actions, with the sidebar containing only the filter summary/list.
Regression tests verify responsive wrapping, accessible group and button state, input labels and focus indicators.
Original operations and tests remain intact; strict POLIS gates and Hermes validation pass, with visual inspection when available.

invariants.statement: No backend, endpoint, model or memory persistence changes.
Search filter, target switch resets, Add entry, compaction preview and Apply remain wired to their existing handlers and disabled rules.
Hermes theme classes and React plugin SDK remain the UI primitives; no new production dependencies.

forbidden_states.statement: Statistics appear as four equal columns or character budget is squeezed next to three data items at Desktop widths.
Search input is separated from selector/action buttons in another panel on desktop.
Narrow window creates horizontally clipped controls, inaccessible switcher or unreadable budget feedback.
Other views, backend memory mutations or profile settings change.

inputs.statement: Clean Magi main branch at 6b8090901aa241f3727de9aa3d8bec1eda2eed53; existing StoredMemoryPage and tests.

outputs.statement: Responsive two-row statistics and combined toolbar in desktop/plugin.js.
Focused tests and POLIS v6 Red/Green proof and package.

failure_semantics.statement: Unknown metrics keep existing zero defaults; free characters clamp at zero; disabled controls stay disabled during operations.
Regression, accessibility or validation failure blocks commit and installation.
